target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, one vCPU, VirtIO input, current desktop ISO and disposable instrumented fixture
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_TEST_DISK=build/tothefront-current-instrumented.img ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tothefront-fire-current-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-tothefront-fire-diag
verified: Selected Human for both players, generated a map, selected Artillery and plotted an adjacent order.
The instrumented fixture reported a legal unit move; graphical input moved unit 0 from cell (13,4) to (11,4).
The fixture placed a live opponent in an adjacent cell and both players completed the direct-fire input path.
Escape returned to the terminal; `40+2;` evaluated successfully and zstatus reported failed=0.
limitations: Movement and direct fire used a disposable instrumented Human.ZC fixture to supply and report legal targets; this does not prove natural full-match or AI behavior.
QEMU test profile only; live UTM and Pi hardware still require separate checks.
